bullets: Wireshark is free - no excuse not to know it
Filter by protocol to spot suspicious traffic fast
SOC interviews often include live packet analysis

caption: Wireshark is free, widely used, and comes up in SOC interviews constantly - yet most candidates have never opened it. That gap is your edge. #cybersecurity #wireshark #soc #cybersecuritycareers #cypherjobs
